svg.title: What's inside the Lumen template: scroll-driven WebGL scene, GSAP and Lenis motion, live mini UIs, adaptive quality, no build step

g.text: Everything a SaaS launch needs. Nothing it doesn't.
A chrome core and 11k particles morph from halo to globe to GPU fabric.
Smooth scroll, pinned story, scroll-fill text, stacking cards, counters.
Pixel budget + auto downgrade on slow GPUs.
Plain HTML, CSS and JS. Host anywhere.
